result.reason: The redline does not reach either playbook position. The primary licence remains non-transferable, provides no successor/M&A transfer right, and does not permit contractors to exercise the general Software and Documentation licence. Contractor use is added only to the conditional source-code/escrow licence. The paid-up licence is not expressly irrevocable, and no compliant termination standard is added for any subscription licence. Affiliates remain limited to those operating at Authorized Locations rather than being addressed through the preferred broad coverage or fallback written-notice mechanism. The added escrow-release triggers materially expand separate commercial rights beyond what is needed for the licence-scope rule and therefore do not preserve the original bargain. Drafting is generally readable but introduces potentially undefined concepts such as a 'severity 1 failure' and an 'agreed period.'
